items.title: British military commander says UK is conducting cyberattacks against Russia
items.summary: A senior British military commander said the United Kingdom is conducting cyber operations against Russia, China, Iran and North Korea. The reported statement did not identify particular targets, operations or their effects.

items.title: Trump reportedly understands Putin's anger over Crimean Bridge attack
items.summary: An NBC journalist recounting an interview with Donald Trump said the US president understood Vladimir Putin's reaction to the attack on the Crimean Bridge. Trump reportedly said Putin was extremely angry with Volodymyr Zelensky over the strike, following a conversation between the two leaders.
